index.html.summary: KYS.Library.Qr Documentation Welcome to KYS.Library.Qr, an add-on to KYS.Library for generating QR codes in internal .NET applications. It draws QR codes (optionally with a centered logo) and outputs them as a bitmap, stream, Base64 string, data URI, or PNG file. This site contains a high-level overview of the library and a full API reference automatically generated from XML documentation comments. 📦 Project Modules KYS.Library.Qr.Services Contains the QR code generation service: IQrGenerator – the contract for drawing a QR code and converting it to different outputs. QrGenerator – the implementation, created through validated factory methods: Create(value) / Create(value, width, height, margin) CreateWithLogo(value, logoPath) / CreateWithLogo(value, logoPath, width, height, margin, logoWidth, logoHeight) Output methods: Draw (SKBitmap), DrawAndToMemoryStream, DrawAndToBase64, DrawAndToDataUri, and DrawAndToFile (PNG). QR codes are generated with error correction level H, so a logo can cover the center without breaking scanning. All factory and output methods return a Result / Result (CSharpFunctionalExtensions) instead of throwing. ⚡ Quick Example using KYS.Library.Qr.Services; // Data URI, ready for an tag Result dataUri = QrGenerator.Create("https://example.com") .Bind(qr => qr.DrawAndToDataUri()); // QR code with a logo, saved as a PNG file Result saved = QrGenerator.CreateWithLogo("https://example.com", "logo.png") .Bind(qr => qr.DrawAndToFile("qr-code.png")); 🚀 Using This Library (Internal Use) Since this library is not currently published to NuGet, it can be consumed by: Cloning or downloading the repository Building the solution Locating the generated DLLs under: KYS.Library.Qr/bin/Debug/net8.0/ or KYS.Library.Qr/bin/Release/net8.0/ Adding the DLL references to your project manually (KYS.Library.Qr depends on KYS.Library, so reference both): In Visual Studio: Project → Add Reference → Browse → Select DLLs In .NET CLI-based project: path/to/KYS.Library.dll path/to/KYS.Library.Qr.dll Adding the third-party NuGet packages used by the library: SkiaSharp, ZXing.Net, ZXing.Net.Bindings.SkiaSharp, and CSharpFunctionalExtensions. When running on Linux (e.g. Docker), also add SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux.NoDependencies. 📘 API Reference Detailed class, method, and property documentation is available under the API section of this site.
